name: Atomic-X
abilities: Celestialsapien reality warping usable at will - no Serena/Bellicus debate needed
Creates orbs of light/black holes without physical effort
Extreme strength (flicked Vilgax into the air with one finger)
Atomic/nuclear energy blasts from his fists
weaknesses: Was erased by the Chronosapien Time Bomb
Vulnerable to a Chronosapien's time rays (Maltruant)
Diluted Celestialsapien DNA makes him weaker than Alien X (Duncan Rouleau); crew statements conflict on whether he is fully omnipotent
summary: Ben 10,000's Biomnitrix fusion of Atomix and Alien X: Alien X's reality-bending power in a body he can actually control, with Atomix's nuclear punch on top. Erased by the Time Bomb, restored, and finally beaten by Maltruant.
traits: Only combination alien whose name doesn't reuse parts of its components' names
Has a mouth, unlike Atomix and Alien X
notableFeats: Tried to stop the Chronosapien Time Bomb and was erased from existence with it (And Then There Were None)
Restored by No Watch Ben as Clockwork, then knocked Vilgax skyward with a finger flick and helped the good Bens win (And Then There Was Ben)
Teleported and conjured light/black-hole orbs at will (And Then There Was Ben)
Battled Maltruant with atomic blasts but was defeated saving Spanner (The End of an Era)

appearances.designNotes: Alien X's starfield body shape with Atomix's upper torso, collarbone, lower jaw, waist, thighs and feet and Atomix's height; large green energy-filled cylinders on the forearms and orbs on the shoulders; eyebrows shaped like Alien X's horns; has a mouth; Biomnitrix symbol on the chest.

scoring.rationale: Celestialsapien-grade reality warping without the personality deadlock (cosmic 9), teleportation, black-hole orbs, and enough strength to flick Vilgax away. Kept off 200 because his DNA is diluted (per Rouleau) and he was erased by a Time Bomb and beaten by Maltruant's time attacks - real, exploitable time-based weaknesses, though far less crippling than Alien X's debate.

notes: Used only by the Omniverse Ben 10,000 via the Biomnitrix (And Then There Were None: non-speaking; And Then There Was Ben: x2 - cameo then non-speaking; The End of an Era).
Omnipotence debate: Derrick J. Wyatt says Atomic-X has Alien X's powers; Duncan Rouleau says any Celestialsapien combination is weaker due to diluted DNA. Wiki leaves it to the reader.

Biomnitrix context: the Omniverse Ben 10,000 (Original Future timeline, re-established as Ben Prime's true future) wears two linked Omnitrix gauntlets; slamming them together fuses two aliens on the fly (combinations are generated at transformation time, not stored). Each gauntlet alone gives normal aliens; it is voice-controlled and can be knocked out by a large EMP or Chronosapien time-freeze. All on-screen fusions were drawn by Thomas N. Perkins IV; the device name was coined by Derrick J. Wyatt (unnamed in scripts).
